hero.subtitle: Talks, a Qiskit workshop, and real IBM quantum hardware.

about.title: What is QuantumJam?
about.description: A Computer Society ITBA event bringing quantum computing closer to anyone who has never touched a qubit and to those already reading papers.

beginner.title: No prior experience needed
beginner.desc: We start from scratch: what a qubit is and what superposition means.

hands_on.title: Hands-on with Qiskit
hands_on.desc: Build and run your first circuit on real IBM hardware.

community.title: Community
community.desc: Technical talks and networking with the Buenos Aires quantum community.

hardware.title: The hardware
hardware.description: IBM Quantum processors hold each qubit in a superconducting chip cooled to millikelvins above absolute zero. Every gold plate of the cryostat shields and progressively cools the chip: gold is the material that best conducts and protects at those temperatures.

fundamentals.title: Fundamentals
fundamentals.desc: Qubits, superposition, and why this is not just a faster PC.

workshop.title: Qiskit Workshop
workshop.desc: Build a circuit and run it on a real IBM quantum processor.

panel.title: Open panel
panel.desc: Researchers, industry, and students discussing the real state of quantum hardware.

sponsor.title: IBM Quantum
sponsor.description: IBM Quantum provides the workshop with real quantum hardware: superconducting processors at millikelvin temperatures, controlled with microwave pulses.

registration.title: Register
registration.description: Every field displays several possible answers at once. On focus, they collapse to yours.

reason.label: Why do you want to come? (optional)

registration.note: Email confirmation in the coming days.

success.title: Measurement made: you are going to QuantumJam
success.desc: The box is open and the cat is fine. Your spot is saved: confirmation lands by email. See you on November 14.

footer.brand_desc: Student community at ITBA. QuantumJam is our annual quantum computing event, sponsored by IBM Quantum.
